result.title: RTAformer: Relation-Transition-Aware Transformer for Video Scene Graph Generation
result.summary: Video scene graph generation (VidSGG) aims to capture objects and their evolving relationships in videos. This requires accounting for both the persistence of object identities and abrupt changes in relationships. Existing methods aggregate information across frames to exploit temporal context, but an emphasis on consistency can obscure these changes. As a result, a model may retain its previous prediction even after the underlying relation has changed. We refer to this failure mode as relational semantic inertia. To address this issue, we propose Relation-Transition-Aware Transformer (RTAformer), a one-stage framework that separately models entity persistence and relation changes. It injects calibrated differences between adjacent-frame relation queries to guide predicate updates, while cross-frame instance alignment during training helps reduce cross-frame representational drift. Experiments on Action Genome show improvements in recall and mean recall over existing methods, with ablation studies supporting the contributions of the proposed components and comparisons using matched backbones showing larger gains on relation-transition frames than on non-transition frames.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 RTAformer 单阶段框架用于视频场景图生成，将实体持续性与关系变化分开建模：用相邻帧关系 query 之间的校准差分引导谓词更新，并在训练时通过跨帧实例对齐减轻表示漂移，以缓解「关系语义惯性」。
AI.relevance_reason: 相邻帧 query 差分驱动状态更新、训练期对齐抑制跨帧表示漂移，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态的更新方式与轨迹监督、以及 latent 相似度受位置/深度影响的问题提供可核查线索；但其任务为视频场景图，需核查差分信号能否迁移到视觉推理状态。
